name: FE (Forge Energy)
description: The shared electricity of many non-Create mods.

pages.title: FE (Forge Energy)
pages.text:
**FE**, Forge Energy, is the electricity many mods share. Create itself runs on rotation, not FE, and the two only meet through converters.\
\
The Alternator turns rotation into FE (from 32 RPM), the Electric Motor turns FE into rotation. FE runs on wires between connectors.
